list: The official 55 trophies, 19 Nov 2026. Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Hidden flags: 28 hidden, 27 visible (Output Lag hidden/visible tables, 19 Nov 2026, agreeing with the 28-hidden total in every list checked). Counts are the PSN counters PSNProfiles shows (0/N), cross-checked against the starter guides and Exophase descriptions, which agree on every name, description and grade. Guides are written for this entry in my own words; each names its source. Where no walkthrough is verified yet the guide says so.
sources: Official trophy list: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy pages, read 19 Nov 2026
Hidden / visible split (28 hidden, 27 visible) and how-to details: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy guide, read 19 Nov 2026
Missable flag: only Positive Mental Attitude is reported possibly missable (Output Lag; EGamers.io)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops with the last one. There is no shortcut: one story playthrough plus the free-roam grind, around 200 hours by launch-week estimates.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. First do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears once the chapter ends, so keep a Chapter 1 save until that trophy pops.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens after Breakfast Run in this chapter, which opens most of the list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Race Against Yago in this chapter is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks: save first, then race.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of this chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep a manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story mission: it pops as you play the story, nothing extra to hunt.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A story mission: it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A story mission: it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A story mission at Vice City International Airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A story mission: it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but work done earlier still counts. It needs, among other things, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Belum terverifikasi in-game: the full checklist is only visible after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going to 300, because 100% completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PSN tracks 0/9, so open the counter to see which types you still owe.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the two shooting ranges. This is one of the hardest grinds on the list.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough; you do not need to win every race.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race only counts the first time you win it, so vary the events instead of repeating one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival; the challenge is a head-to-head. Belum terverifikasi in-game: no verified walkthrough of the challenge exists yet.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so pick the shortest one.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand stays open after the story, so finish his missions in order at your own pace. Note: Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. A side-story finale that stays open after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. A side-story finale; Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the PSN counter after each strand you finish.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. A side-story finale that stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. A side-story finale; Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating with both characters at a spot should count twice, so bring your partner every time. MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears once the chapter ends. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops. This is the only trophy any source flags as possibly missable.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are a free-roam collectible; finish three full sets, not just three cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good, so scan traffic as you drive and both counters move.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges and many complete on their own while you play; 100% completion needs 70 of the 80.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Easiest during a bank vault escape, which gives 4 stars at once; the trophy only pops once you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner first, then rob three shops in a row while the police still chase you; if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning traffic with the WAiNK app counts as discovering, so scan as you drive; 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3 + R3 while aiming): pick a group, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge: the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Go to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off; fly about 1 km away and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast. Belum terverifikasi in-game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (a Rhino). Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, drive and fire until it pops. Belum terverifikasi in-game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on a store's locked back door, because kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Belum terverifikasi in-game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone. Belum terverifikasi in-game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It only pops once you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until you are fully clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. PSN tracks 0/52; the counter tells you how many areas you still owe.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. 100% completion wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way if you clear them all.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Belum terverifikasi in-game: no source checked gives a confirmed unlock method for this one, only its official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Belum terverifikasi in-game: no source checked gives a confirmed unlock method for this one, only its official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2: bring Sticky Bombs, take all three key valuables (the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, the office safe contents), then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable. Belum terverifikasi in-game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Per Output Lag it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength: buy a gym membership and train with your partner, since the partner trains alongside you. Unconfirmed by any second source. Belum terverifikasi in-game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind while you chase the rest of the list.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger is a hidden second-chance event; the exact method is unverified in every source checked. Belum terverifikasi in-game: do not trust any specific step until a walkthrough confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Belum terverifikasi in-game: no source checked gives a confirmed unlock method for this one, only its official description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Belum terverifikasi in-game: no source checked gives confirmed trigger details for this one, only its official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts; the $250,000 total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it fills while you buy garages, cars and gear for the rest of the list.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000; garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens via the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first.
